active_location.macro_silhouette: The hearth is loud and warm. It is filled with the smell of iron-wheat bread. The fire crackles with orange lightning.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Bright orange arcs of lightning geode fire.
sensory_palette.sound: Deafening crackle of heavy wood on brass.
sensory_palette.smell: Ozone, burnt metallic dust, and freshly baked iron-wheat.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: Oppressively hot and dry next to the fire.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: Copper and salt on the tongue.

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be stirred to distribute heat evenly.
Can overload if not carefully monitored with the bellows.
Can quench overheating pans and tempers.

reactive_toys.consistent_method: Rising tides of metallic fluid seeping from the floorboards.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: Breaches the lower fire pit seal.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: Will flood the dining floor in 3 rounds.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The shear is tearing the hearth.

graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: It holds, but damages the stew.

broadcast_script: Good evening, Enclave! Dorian and Vex reporting from The Hub on Sol 1. Tonight we feast at the Hearth.
segment_text: Ryn glared at the brass stew pot. The iron-wheat was almost ready. She checked the chronometer. She turned and handed the heavy, warm copper ladle over to Silas.
